versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the skill for intelligent recognition and information extraction of China account opening permits based on the Laiye ADP platform.
- Supports accurate extraction of key fields such as approval number, permit number, basic deposit account, legal representative, bank, and account number, outputting structured JSON.
- Offers out-of-the-box use with zero configuration required; suitable for enterprise qualification verification and business information inquiry scenarios.
- Includes step-by-step integration guide, CLI usage instructions, batch and asynchronous processing support.
- Provides standardized output format for extracted fields and detailed field mapping.
- Free quota available for new users: up to 200 extractions per month.
